response.sql:
WITH category_totals AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        AVG(remaining) AS average_remaining,
        SUM(amount - spent) AS total
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount >= 75
    GROUP BY category
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(total) AS average_total
    FROM category_totals
)
SELECT
    c.category,
    c.average_remaining,
    c.total,
    c.total - o.average_total AS above_average
FROM category_totals AS c
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE c.total > o.average_total;

assumptions.assumption: A row contributes to a category total only when both amount and spent are present; categories with no such rows have a blank total and are excluded from the overall average.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat amount and spent as separate sums, ignoring missing values in each independently, then subtract the sums for each category.
